newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petsec Q2 gas, oil production a record.
newsitem.headline: Petsec Q2 gas, oil production a record.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Petsec Energy Ltd said on Thursday its second quarter production was a record 13.62 billion cubic feet equivalent (bcfe), a rise of six percent on the March quarter.
The record total was made up of 987,516 barrels of oil and 7,697 milion cubic feet of gas.
The company's main producing assets are the Ship Shoal 192, 193 and 194 areas offshore Louisiana in the Gulf of Mexico in the U.S.
Gross production from these areas accounted for 729,354 barrels of oil and 1,659 million cubic feet of gas (mmcf), increases of 14 percent and 28 percent respectively.
In the same area, West Cameron had gross production of 191,974 barrles of oil and 3,449 million cubic feet of gas, similar to the last quarter.
Main Pass 6, 7 and 91 produced slightly lower volumes of 66,077 barrels of oil and 2,450 million cubic feet of gas.
